name: EWP World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The promotion's own top title, planned to be crowned in an eight-man tournament at its own Halloween Brawl '99 pay-per-view; no result survives in the record.

name: EWP United Kingdom Championship
epitaph: The promotion's own second-ranked title, described as defended on every card; no champion is recorded in the surviving documents.

name: EWP World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: The promotion's own tag title; no champions are recorded in the surviving documents.

name: EWP World Juniorweight Championship
epitaph: The promotion's own title for wrestlers under 235 pounds; no champion is recorded in the surviving documents.
